title: Terminal Station (Macon, Georgia)

buildingCutout.basis: Suppresses ordinary generated massing within the exact named OpenStreetMap station outline.

terrainReference.basis: The independent ground at the center of the Cherry Street forecourt.

mapIdentity.scope: The named OpenStreetMap station outline establishes the full span, depth and forward central section. Cherry Street fixes the principal front.

note: Published early views establish the three-story bays, setback end wings, broad pediment and fanlight, monumental arched opening, ornamental eagles, attic wreath panels and low ridge roofs.
